description: Qwen3.5-4B for the RK1828 PCIe NPU. Rockchip's pre-converted export for RKNN3 V1.1.0 (RKNN3_SDK/rknn3_models/v1.1.0/llm/Qwen3.5-4B, linked from the rknn3-model-zoo README section 2.10), W4A16 group32 per examples/Qwen3_5. The four files are a MATCHED SET from one export. Needs the V1.1.0 runtime on the host (librknn3_api 1.1.0); served by the same worker as Qwen3-4B (--model-name Qwen3.5-4B).

runtime.note: Defaults the entrypoint applies for this model; RK1828_MAX_CONTEXT / RK1828_TOOL_CALL_FORMAT / RK1828_KV_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL / RK1828_KV_CHECKPOINT_COUNT override them.

files.name: Qwen3.5-4B.embed.bin
files.role: embedding table (mmapped on the HOST, does not consume EP memory)
